Name: PureBinarySave (Test)
Author: palmhacker13
Description:
[center]
[size=6][b][color=#d48806]PureBinarySave[/color][/b][/size]
[size=4][i]A lightweight, non-intrusive save and load optimization mod for Stardew Valley 1.6+[/i][/size]

[b][color=#1890ff]Instant Bedtime Saves[/color]  •  [color=#52c41a]Sub-Second Loading[/color]  •  [color=#fa8c16]Auto-Syncing Vanilla XML[/color][/b]
[/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]📖 What Does This Mod Do?[/b][/size]

In vanilla Stardew Valley (especially with mods installed), save files are stored as large, uncompressed XML text files—often reaching [b]15 to 30+ MB[/b].

Whenever your farmer goes to sleep, the game pauses everything on a black screen while writing this massive text file to your disk. When loading a save, reading and parsing that large XML file causes noticeable load screen wait times.

[b]PureBinarySave[/b] streamlines this process:
[list=1]
[*][b]Lightweight Storage[/b]: Saves are compressed into a compact binary format ([font=Courier New].bin[/font], ~900 KB) using zero-allocation streaming.[/*]
[*][b]Smooth Night Transitions[/b]: At bedtime, the game saves to the fast binary format first, allowing you to transition into the morning without the prolonged black screen pause.[/*]
[*][b]Background Vanilla Backups[/b]: After you wake up at 6:00 AM, a background worker quietly mirrors your save back into standard vanilla XML format. Your save files remain genuine Stardew Valley saves at all times.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]⚡ The Performance Duo: Combo with UltraSmooth[/b][/size]
[/center]

[quote]
If you want the complete performance package for Stardew Valley, this mod is designed as the direct sister companion to [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971][b][color=#1890ff]UltraSmooth[/color][/b][/url]:
[list]
[*][b] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/50971]UltraSmooth[/url] [/b]handles the rendering engine: uncapped high-refresh rates (144Hz+), precision frame pacing, frustum culling, and zero-stutter gameplay.[/*]
[*][b][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54266]PureBinarySave[/url] [/b]handles the I/O pipeline: eliminating bedtime save freezes and title-screen loading delays.[/*]
[*]They seamlessly communicate with each other: PureBinarySave throttles its background XML sync whenever UltraSmooth detects heavy in-game frame activity to guarantee zero micro-stutter. Furthermore, when running [b]A/B Testing Mode[/b], UltraSmooth automatically suspends its internal save/load optimizations so you measure the 100% genuine vanilla baseline.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]✨ Features[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Faster Bedtime Saves[/b]: Greatly reduces the black-screen saving delay when going to sleep.[/*]
[*][b]Faster Load Times[/b]: Reads compact binary data and utilizes idle title-screen time to prepare your save in memory.[/*]
[*][b]Automatic Vanilla XML Mirroring[/b]: Keeps a full, standard XML backup synchronized in the background.[/*]
[*][b]Auto-Healing Protection[/b]: If an XML file is ever interrupted (e.g., sudden power cut or crash), the mod automatically reconstructs a healthy XML file from the binary data upon game launch.[/*]
[*][b]Atomic Save Safety[/b]: Saves are written to temporary files and verified with checksums before replacing existing files. Your previous day's backup is always preserved.[/*]
[*][b]Safe & Clean Reversibility[/b]: You are never locked into this mod. A built-in one-click reversion feature restores clean vanilla saves whenever you want.[/*]
[*][b]Built-in A/B Testing[/b]: Compare loading times between vanilla XML and binary directly via config or console to see the difference on your own machine.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🛡️ Save Integrity & Safety[/b][/size]

I treat save data with the utmost caution:
[list]
[*]The mod [b]does NOT alter game objects, item data, or custom mod data[/b]. It uses the game's official native [font=Courier New]SaveGame.serializer[/font] to produce the exact same data—only the on-disk storage format is compressed.[/*]
[*]Compatible with [b]SpaceCore[/b], [b]Content Patcher[/b], custom mod items, and multiplayer.[/*]
[*]Atomic file replacement ensures that if power is lost during saving, the previous day's save remains untouched and safe.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[center]
[size=5][b]⚠️ Cautions & Good Practices[/b][/size]
[/center]

[quote]
While the mod has automated safety nets, please keep these points in mind:
[list]
[*][b]Wait a few seconds after waking up before Alt+F4[/b]: At 6:00 AM, the mod takes about 5–6 seconds to finish syncing the vanilla XML file in the background. While your [font=Courier New].bin[/font] save is already safe, waiting ensures the vanilla XML backup is also up-to-date.[/*]
[*][b]Sharing saves or using web tools[/b]: If you want to send your save file to a friend playing vanilla, or upload it to websites like [i]Stardew Checkup[/i], run the console command [font=Courier New]restore_xml <SaveFolder>[/font] first so external tools can read the XML.[/*]
[*][b]Pure Disk Mode[/b]: If you choose to enable the optional "Pure Disk Mode" (which disables XML writing completely to save SSD space), vanilla Stardew Valley will not see your saves until you run [font=Courier New]restore_xml[/font] or disable the option.[/*]
[/list][/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]📥 Installation & Menu Support[/b][/size]

[list=1]
[*]Install [b]SMAPI[/b] (version 4.0+).[/*]
[*]Download this mod and unzip [font=Courier New]PureBinarySave[/font] into your [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font] folder.[/*]
[*]Play the game! Everything works out of the box with zero setup required.[/*]
[/list]
[b]In-Game Config Menus:[/b]
Fully compatible with both [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]Modern Config Menu (MCM)[/b][/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]Generic Mod Config Menu (GMCM)[/b][/url]. You can configure settings and test modes directly from the in-game title screen.

[color=#d48806][size=4][b]📌 Important: First-Time Setup & Save File Behavior[/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b]Existing Saves (Created Before Installing PureBinarySave):[/b]
When you load an existing save for the very first time after installing [b]PureBinarySave[/b], the loading time will be the [b]standard vanilla duration[/b]. This is completely normal and intended!
Because your existing save only contains original vanilla XML files, [b]PureBinarySave must pass through one normal vanilla load first[/b] so the game can read your data into memory.
Once you play through the day and [b]go to sleep to save at bedtime[/b], [b]PureBinarySave[/b] will automatically compress and generate the optimized [font=Courier New].bin[/font] binary file.
[color=#52c41a][b]From your second load onward, and for every bedtime save thereafter, the full binary acceleration takes effect permanently![/b][/color]
[/*]
[*][b]New Saves (Created After Installing PureBinarySave):[/b]
For any new character or farm created after installing [b]PureBinarySave[/b], the mod is active from the very beginning. As soon as you finish Day 1 and go to sleep, [b]PureBinarySave[/b] writes the binary file immediately. [color=#52c41a][b]Every load and save will enjoy maximum speed from day one with no extra steps.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]💻 Console Commands[/b][/size]

You can run these commands in the SMAPI console at any time:

[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_status[/b][/font] — Shows current load/save timing breakdown and file size comparison.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_mode [binary|xml][/b][/font] — Switches between PureBinary loader and vanilla XML loader for A/B testing.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_revert_all[/b][/font] — Restores all saves to clean vanilla XML and removes all [font=Courier New].bin[/font] files.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_revert <SaveFolder>[/b][/font] — Restores a specific save folder to vanilla XML and removes its [font=Courier New].bin[/font] files.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]restore_xml <SaveFolder>[/b][/font] — Reconstructs the XML file from binary without removing [font=Courier New].bin[/font] files.[/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b]pbs_test_roundtrip <SaveFolder>[/b][/font] — Performs a bit-exact verification test on a save folder.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]🧪 How to Benchmark & Test the Speed Difference (A/B Test)[/b][/size]

Want to measure the real loading speed difference on your own PC? Follow this step-by-step benchmark guide to ensure an accurate, fair comparison:

[quote]
[color=#f5222d][b]⚠️ STEP 0: Prerequisites Before Testing[/b][/color]
[list=1]
[*][b]Temporarily remove other load/save mods:[/b] If you have mods that touch loading, fast-loading, caching, or saving, please move them out of your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] folder during this test. Having them enabled will skew the baseline.[/*]
[*][b]Use an existing, already-converted save file:[/b]
Do [b]NOT[/b] use a brand-new farm created 5 seconds ago! New saves haven't been saved at bedtime yet, so they don't have binary data.
[i]Use a save that has already loaded into the game and slept in bed at least once with PureBinarySave installed (so its [font=Courier New].bin[/font] file is generated).[/i][/*]
[/list][/quote]
[size=4][b]📊 The Benchmark Steps (Before vs. After):[/b][/size]

[b]Step 1 — Test BEFORE (Vanilla XML Speed):[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game to the title screen.[/*]
[*]Open config menu ([b]MCM[/b] or [b]GMCM[/b]) > [b]PureBinarySave[/b] > turn [b]A/B Testing Mode: ON[/b] (this forces the game to load via standard Vanilla XML).[/*]
[*]Click [b]Load[/b] and select your test save. Note the loading time on screen / SMAPI console.[/*]
[*]Exit and [b]completely close the game[/b].[/*]
[/list]
[b]Step 2 — Test AFTER (PureBinarySave Speed):[/b]
[list=1]
[*]Launch the game fresh to the title screen again.[/*]
[*]Open config menu > [b]PureBinarySave[/b] > turn [b]A/B Testing Mode: OFF[/b] (enables PureBinary acceleration).[/*]
[*]Select the [b]exact same save file[/b] as Step 1 and load into it.[/*]
[*]Check your new loading time![/*]
[/list]
[quote]
💡 [b]How to verify numbers accurately:[/b]
After loading, you can check the SMAPI console or type [font=Courier New][b]pbs_status[/b][/font] to view the exact millisecond timing breakdown recorded by the mod![/quote]
[line]

[size=5][b]🗑️ How to Safely Uninstall[/b][/size]

I believe every performance mod should be easy to remove:
[list=1]
[*]In-game, open your config menu ([url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/49437][b]MCM[/b][/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098][b]GMCM[/b][/url]) > [b]PureBinarySave[/b] > scroll to the bottom and check [b]"Revert All Saves To Clean Vanilla XML"[/b], then save.
[i](Or simply type [font=Courier New]pbs_revert_all[/font] into the SMAPI console.)[/i][/*]
[*]Close the game.[/*]
[*]Delete the [font=Courier New]PureBinarySave[/font] folder from your [font=Courier New]Mods[/font] directory.[/*]
[*]Your saves are now 100% clean vanilla XML files, exactly as if the mod was never installed.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]❓ FAQ[/b][/size]

[b]Q: Will this corrupt my save or delete my items?[/b]
A: No. The mod does not modify game logic, items, or NPCs. It only changes how the save stream is stored and compressed on disk using the game's standard serializer.

[b]Q: Can I use save editors or upload my save to Stardew Checkup?[/b]
A: Yes! Because the mod maintains standard vanilla XML files in the background, external web tools and save editors can read your save folder normally.

[b]Q: Is it safe to add mid-playthrough?[/b]
A: Yes! Existing saves will be read normally and automatically converted to binary format upon your next save.

[b]Q: Why didn't I notice faster loading the very first time I loaded my existing save?[/b]
A: Saves created before installing [b]PureBinarySave[/b] do not have a binary file yet—only the game's original XML files. Therefore, [b]PureBinarySave[/b] must read the save via the standard vanilla method for [b]one initial time[/b]. As soon as you go to sleep in bed and save, [b]PureBinarySave[/b] automatically generates the high-speed [font=Courier New].bin[/font] file. From your next load onward, it will load via high-speed binary. (Any new farm started after installing [b]PureBinarySave[/b] will have binary acceleration right from day one!)
